# Semply Ebook Reader — Complete System & Architecture Documentation

> Official comprehensive technical and user documentation for Semply Ebook Reader — a free, offline-first, distraction-free desktop workstation for reading EPUB, PDF (with native HiDPI canvas viewing and offline MuPDF Reflow Mode), MOBI, and TXT books on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Semply Ebook Reader requires no account, no subscription, and zero cloud dependencies for core reading, cover extraction, full-book search, annotations, PDF reflow, or library backups. All personal data, notes, and reading states remain strictly on the user's local hard drive.

---

## Documentation Index & Deep Links

### 1. Start Here & Foundations
- [Complete User Guide (HTML)](./index.html): Interactive documentation with live typography previews, Auto-Scroll pace calculator, and searchable chapters.
- [Complete Plaintext Manual (Markdown)](./llms-full.txt): Comprehensive single-file reference document designed for full-context LLM ingestion.
- [Supported Formats & Platform Installers](./index.html#getting-started): EPUB 2/3, PDF with selectable text, MOBI, and plain TXT on Windows (NSIS x64), macOS (DMG/ZIP), and Linux (AppImage/DEB).
- [Zero-Telemetry Local Privacy Model](./index.html#getting-started): Strict local sandbox; zero accounts, no analytics tracking, no forced cloud sync.

### 2. Library Management & Cataloging
- [Library Views & Shelf Organization](./index.html#library-and-import): Responsive Book Cover Grid and sortable 5-column List View (`Title`, `Author`, `Date`, `Notes`, `Progress`).
- [Book Import Pipeline](./index.html#library-and-import): Single/multi-file picker, recursive folder scanner, drag-and-drop ingestion, and bulk shelf assignment.
- [Automated Cover Extraction & Miniature First Page](./index.html#library-and-import): Embedded cover discovery, PDF Page 1 rasterization, clean filename normalization, and crisp warm-paper first-page typesetting for coverless documents.
- [Dynamic Custom Categories](./index.html#library-and-import): Color-coded custom shelves with 9 preset palettes or custom hex swatches.
- [Smart Viewport-Flipping Context Menus](./index.html#library-and-import): 4-way boundary checking with mousewheel support and consolidated "Move to:" submenu.

### 3. In-App Book Browser ("Get Books")
- [Curated Directory Hub](./index.html#get-books-browser): Pre-populated directory of verified, reliable public domain and free e-book libraries (Standard Ebooks, Project Gutenberg, Open Library, Internet Archive, LibriVox, ManyBooks, Ocean of PDF, PDF Drive, D-PDF, ReadAnyBook, BDeBooks).
- [Isolated Sandboxed Webview Architecture](./index.html#get-books-browser): `persist:bookbrowser` session partition locked to verified domains, preventing arbitrary URL browsing or untrusted redirects.
- [3-Tier Custom Site Validation](./index.html#get-books-browser): Multi-stage filter (Tier 1: instant non-book blocklist; Tier 2: metadata and title keyword verification; Tier 3: e-book download format signatures) ensuring users can safely add self-hosted OPDS, Calibre-web, or indie portals.
- [Direct Downloads & Library Auto-Indexing](./index.html#get-books-browser): File streams save directly into the user's OS `Downloads` folder, immediately register in IndexedDB at the top of the shelf, and display a WhatsApp-style green unread badge until opened.
- [Offline Resilience Screen](./index.html#get-books-browser): Calm, native in-app retry card replacing Chromium network error and dinosaur pages.

### 4. Reading Experience & Typography
- [Minimalist Reader Toolbar](./index.html#reading-experience): Left drawer controls (`Library`, `Contents`, `Notes`, `Bookmarks`, `Find`) and right utilities (`Immersive Fullscreen`, `Settings`).
- [4 Bookmaker Reading Themes](./index.html#reading-experience): `Light` (Day), `Paper` (Warm Sepia), `Dusk` (Dark Sepia), and `Obsidian` (True Dark).
- [Classic Bookmaker Typefaces](./index.html#reading-experience): Publisher original, Sans, Serif, and Monospace with fine font sizing and line spacing options.
- [True Immersive Fullscreen (F11)](./index.html#reading-experience): Zero-chrome reading with auto-concealing cursor (10s inactivity) and tactile "Go to Page" bracket box.
- [Content-Only Zoom](./index.html#reading-experience): `Ctrl + +`, `Ctrl + -`, and `Ctrl + 0` scale document text or PDF canvas without resizing UI buttons.

### 5. Native PDF & Offline MuPDF Reflow
- [HiDPI PDF Canvas Viewer](./index.html#pdf-and-reflow): Sharp text-layer alignment, dual-page spread (`F10`), smooth edge scrolling, and outline navigation.
- [One-Click Offline Reflow Mode](./index.html#pdf-and-reflow): Client-side Artifex MuPDF WASM engine stripping headers/footers, preserving code blocks/headings, rasterizing complex diagrams, and enabling full EPUB feature access.
- [Offline EPUB Export](./index.html#pdf-and-reflow): Convert any PDF into a standalone `.epub` file directly on disk.

### 6. Annotations, Notes & Full-Book Search
- [Theme-Aware Highlights](./index.html#notes-highlights-bookmarks): 6 highlight styles (Yellow, Blue, Green, Purple, Red, Underline) blending dynamically with theme luminosity.
- [Second-Brain Note Export](./index.html#notes-highlights-bookmarks): Searchable notes drawer with export to HTML, Markdown (.md), and Plain Text.
- [Auto-Excerpt Bookmarks](./index.html#notes-highlights-bookmarks): `Ctrl + B` captures page location and leading sentence for effortless review.
- [Full-Book Live Search (Ctrl+F)](./index.html#search-in-book): Spine-wide multi-chapter search with amber excerpts and keyboard match stepping.

### 7. Automation, Accessibility & Comfort
- [Dual-Mode Auto-Scroll](./index.html#auto-scroll): Fixed Timer mode (`3–600s`) and Smart Pace adaptive mode (scales duration dynamically to visible word density with 300ms break micro-pauses).
- [Read Aloud (TTS)](./index.html#read-aloud-and-lookup): Web Speech Synthesis with pronunciation normalization (decimals, acronyms, Roman numeral chapters).
- [Inline Dictionary & Wikipedia Lookups](./index.html#read-aloud-and-lookup): Instant popover definitions and encyclopedic summaries without losing reading position.
- [Non-Destructive Footnote Peeking](./index.html#read-aloud-and-lookup): Bottom modal peek for footnotes and cross-chapter endnotes.
- [Hardware-Independent Warm Night Filter](./index.html#eye-comfort): 2000K–4500K blue-light amber overlay with separate viewport dimming.

### 8. Backup, Synchronization & Updates
- [Additive Sync & Deduplication](./index.html#backup-and-sync): Non-destructive JSON and ZIP archive export/import merging highlights, notes, and shelves safely.
- [Gentle Update Flow](./index.html#updates): Disables aggressive background auto-updates; notifies users with "What's New" release notes and "Update Now" / "Later" actions, maintaining a subtle red badge on Settings when deferred.
